verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vue's official component-testing tools (@vue/test-utils, Vitest), typed props inference, and an llms.txt docs bundle for LLMs. None of it documents an AI capability that generates component tests from declared props or reactive state. These are building blocks a developer or an external AI tool could use, not the capability itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can have AI generate component-level tests based on the props and reactive state my component declares
